Our ideal candidate is attuned with the ever-changing rules of the US market and client journeys and energized by fostering deep emotional connections between the Brand, its existing and potential clients. This position orchestrates the full marketing ecosystem with a strategic mindset, inspiring and promoting a collaborative partnership with DCX, Brand Communication and Artistic Direction teams, locally and globally. Translate global brand strategies into locally relevant, highâimpact plans that reinforce CHANELâs local leadership in luxury fragrance and beauty, while in return promoting US market and client realities towards Global teams, to ensure that these specific needs are understood and translated into product and orchestration strategies. Be the voice of the Brand to communicate CHANELâs vision and support priorities to our Retailers and Market Teams, inspiring alignment and ambition. Category Expertise Across the Three Axis Demonstrate deep strategic and operational mastery of Fragrance, Skincare, and Makeup, understanding category dynamics, competitive landscapes, and client evolving motivations, to orchestrate locally relevant activations and nourish Global MTP product plans. Guide category teams to build longâterm equity while delivering shortâterm business performance, supervising and consolidating A&P budget by axis, facilitating prioritization and monitoring sales performance and ROI to adapt plans and investments in real time. Commission and interpret marketing intelligence, consumer research, competitive analysis, and trend forecasting to inform strategy. Beyond campaigns, ensure â with the support of the DCX and BC teams â that we create relevant and always-on connection across touchpoints of the clientâs journeys (events, digital activations, retail experiences, servicesâ¦), to convey the Houseâs storytelling through elevated and innovative multiâchannel expressions, elevating client lifetime value. Lead in a fluid world: operate in a composable marketing model where teams and skills reconfigure around outcomes, not just fixed roles. Client Journey & Experience Expertise Bring a sophisticated understanding of modern F&B client journeys across online and offline ecosystems for each product axis. Partner with DCX and Retail teams to ensure that every online and offline interactionâ from digital discovery, in-store experience, events or postâpurchase engagement â feels seamless and reflects the Houseâs signature level of service. Create unforgettable moments: together with the Artistic and Education teams, support the Retail to deliver extraordinary in-store and event experiences, consistent with Brandâs standards. Leverage insights and data to anticipate the expectations of the diverse US clientele (esp younger targets) and shape meaningful, personalized experiences for launches and core product offer. Leadership & Team Development Inspire, mentor, and develop highâperforming teams, nurturing curiosity and innovative spirit, accountability, and crossâfunctional collaboration. Foster a culture of operational excellence aligned with Chanelâs image and values, where team members also feel empowered to bring âout of the boxâ ideas to create Brand magic and unique story-telling. Lead with agility and promote simplification: guide an evolving organization, where roles continuously reconfigure as AIâs impact rises. Continuously assess what to automate, augment or eliminate, focusing teams on Brand priorities and high-value work. Partner with P&O to pilot adaptive organization principles when relevant. Strategic Partnership & Influence Develop strong relationships and trust with leaders of the rest of the marketing ecosystem (DCX, AD, Brand Comm) and collaborate with global and regional stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and bestâinâclass execution. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work and the value we deliver to our clients. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, accountability, and a strong commitment to execution. WORK ENVIRONMENT: Nymbus is a remote-first company. Occasional travel may be required for client engagements, team planning sessions, or project activities. Working hours primarily align with the Eastern Time Zone; candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred. While standard business hours are expected, occasional after-hours support may be required for critical operational activities. POSITION SUMMARY: The Enterprise IT Support Specialist provides day-to-day technical and operational support for Enterprise IT. This role is responsible for onboarding and offboarding employees, identity and access management, endpoint administration, and supporting the technologies employees rely on every day. This is more than a traditional Help Desk role. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and leveraging AI and automation to make Enterprise IT more efficient. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for employees across hardware, software, SaaS applications, and collaboration tools. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve IT-related issues. Manage onboarding, offboarding, account provisioning, and access changes. Administer identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, user accounts, and permissions. Configure, deploy, and support macOS and Windows devices using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms. Document, prioritize, and resolve support requests using the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform. Maintain IT assets, software licensing, and operational documentation. Collaborate with other IT teams to resolve technical issues and improve Enterprise IT operations. QUALIFICATIONS: 3+ years of experience in IT Support, Enterprise IT, or Systems Administration. Experience supporting macOS and Windows environments. Experience with identity and access management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Mobile Device Management (MDM). Experience with cloud-based SaaS applications and ITSM platforms. Strong troubleshooting, communication, organization, and customer service skills. Self-starter with strong ownership, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset. Preferred Qualifications Experience with JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Jamf, or similar platforms. Experience with Jira Service Management. Familiarity with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other automation tools. AI-First Expectations AI is transforming Enterprise IT, and we expect every member of our team to embrace it as part of how they work. Successful candidates will: Think AI first before approaching repetitive or manual work. Use AI to improve productivity, documentation, troubleshooting, and communication. Identify opportunities to automate routine tasks and improve operational efficiency. Continuously learn and apply new AI capabilities responsibly and securely. SALARY & BENEFITS: Hourly pay: $38.00 Annual Cash Bonus and Equity Options commensurate with the role level and experience 100% Remote 401(k) plan Insurance - Health, Dental and Vision Paid Time Off Ready to join? We invite you to watch this video and learn who we are and how we build and innovates together! Let's Go! job.title: Backend Developer
job.jdText: albo albo is a leading fintech company offering financial products to individuals and SMBs with the mission to bring financial freedom to everyone everywhere. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer you'll design, build, and operate the microservices that power albo's core financial products â from card issuing and authorization to credit lines, payments, and money movement. You'll own services end-to-end across our polyglot, event-driven platform, making pragmatic architectural decisions that keep money-critical flows correct, idempotent, and observable at scale. You'll work close to the domain (SPEI, ledgers, credit, authorization) and close to production, partnering with Product, Infra, and other engineering squads to ship reliable financial infrastructure. What Youâll Be Doing At Albo Design, build, and maintain backend microservices in Go and Java/Quarkus within our domain-oriented architecture (customer, account, transactional, and shared domains). Own services end-to-end: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment to QA/SBX/PROD, monitoring, and on-call ownership of what you ship. Build event-driven and REST integrations across services (Pub/Sub, service-to-service REST via our private-proxy mesh), with strong guarantees around idempotency, reconciliation, and failure handling (dead-letter/reprocess, no silent data loss). Model and evolve data across MongoDB and SingleStore/MemSQL, keeping dual-write flows consistent between the display source of truth and what card authorization actually validates. Ship through our CI/CD (Jenkins shared pipelines, containerized deploys to GKE/Kubernetes on GCP), managing configuration and secrets via GCP Secret Manager. Write clean, self-documenting, well-tested code; participate in code reviews and raise the engineering bar for correctness and simplicity. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Infra/Platform, and other backend squads to break down epics into shippable, incremental deliveries. Instrument observability (structured logging, metrics, tracing) and use it to debug production issues and continuously improve reliability and performance. Contribute to technical design docs, architecture diagrams, and shared conventions/scaffolding that scale the team. About You And What Type Of Skills You'll Need Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience). +5 years of experience building and operating backend services in production, ideally in the Banking or Fintech industry. Strong proficiency in at least one of Go or Java (Quarkus/Spring or similar), and willingness to work across both in a polyglot environment. Solid experience with microservices and distributed systems: REST APIs, asynchronous/event-driven messaging (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar), service boundaries, and versioned contracts. Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), containers and Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Comfort with both SQL and NoSQL data stores (MongoDB, SingleStore/MySQL/Postgres) and an eye for data consistency in money-critical flows. Deep understanding of reliability patterns â idempotency, retries, reconciliation, graceful degradation â and why they matter when handling real money. Familiarity with fintech/payments concepts (card authorization, ledgers, transfers, credit) is a strong plus. Customer Centricity: You're customer-obsessed, constantly thinking about improving the customer experience. Hands-on: We're looking for a comfortable and willing leader to be a hands-on contributor who is energized by rolling up their sleeves, making things happen, and enabling the team to do the same. Done is better than perfect: As things change and move quickly, you are excited by the fast pace and opportunity to constantly learn and help your team learn. Communication: Excellent ability to communicate internally and externally, quickly build relationships, and work cross-functionally. Extreme ownership: You hold yourself accountable to a high bar. You are supremely organized and see what needs to happen to achieve goals. Results & Data Driven: You understand the business metrics you are responsible for, and you demonstrate these insights to drive constant improvement.
